originalTitle: The Fire and the Sun: Why Plato Banished the Artists

presentation.fr: Tiré de sa Romanes Lecture de 1976, l'essai examine pourquoi <ph id='plato'>Platon</ph> bannit les artistes de la cité. <ph id='iris-murdoch'>Murdoch</ph>, platonicienne et romancière, lui donne raison contre l'art qui console et tort contre le grand art, qu'elle tient pour une voie vers la vérité.
presentation.en: Drawn from her 1976 Romanes Lecture, the essay asks why <ph id='plato'>Plato</ph> banished the artists from the city. <ph id='iris-murdoch'>Murdoch</ph>, a Platonist and a novelist, agrees with him about art that consoles and disagrees about great art, which she holds to be a path to truth.
